guidanceConsulted.query: accessible navigation landmarks skip links semantic HTML
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap content in semantic landmarks (<main>, <header>, <nav>, <footer>), maintain sequential headings, provide descriptive titles on iframes, use semantic tables with <caption> and <th scope>, and wire keyboard-focusable scroll containers with aria-labelledby.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: semantic landmarks, On-this-page <nav class='local-nav'>, descriptive title on the showcase <iframe>, captioned tables with <th scope='col|row'>, and focusable .table-wrap regions with :focus-visible outlines.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table mobile overflow typography code blocks dark mode
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use max-inline-size: 100% with horizontal scrolling on wide tables and constrain embedded media/iframes with max-width: 100% so narrow viewports never incur horizontal page overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .table-wrap uses max-inline-size: 100%, wide tables scroll horizontally inside .table-wrap, and .example-embed iframe uses max-width: 100% with display: block.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table mobile overflow typography code blocks dark mode
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Preserve balanced headings and scrollable code blocks without overriding shared typography rules inline.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: inherits heading, inline code, blockquote, and pre scrolling styles directly from /public/styles.css.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table mobile overflow typography code blocks dark mode
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic CSS custom properties from the shared design system so both light and dark themes maintain accessible contrast.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: zero hardcoded colors in page inline <style>; iframe border and focus outline use var(--border-black) and var(--accent-blue).
